parameters.name: all
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete all custom tags. This parameter takes effect only when `tag_keys` is empty. Valid values:

- `true`: Delete all tags.
- `false`: Do not delete all tags.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: resource_ids
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: tag_keys
parameters.description: The list of tag keys for the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys.
